utterances.speaker: THE PRESIDING JUDGE
utterances.text: Good morning. Yesterday we had the hearing on the Prosecutor's application for deferral in this matter. Today we will announce the disposition. It is as follows: (The decision of the Trial Chamber was read) Are there additional matters that need to be considered at this time from the Prosecutor, please?

utterances.speaker: THE PRESIDING JUDGE
utterances.text: From Mr. Babic? Are there any additional matters, Mr. Babic, that you wish to raise at this time?

utterances.speaker: MR. BABIC
utterances.text: No, your Honour, there is nothing special. I would just like to say the following. I would just like to share with you one remark. The decisions are being made in a very short time, and that could be at the detriment of the preparation of the Defence counsel. Therefore, I would like to ask you to try to avoid it in the future to the extent, if possible.

utterances.speaker: THE PRESIDING JUDGE
utterances.text: Mr. Babic, how is the defence counsel suffering to its detriment?

utterances.speaker: MR. BABIC
utterances.text: If we were to have soon the first hearing, the initial appearance and the indictment, before this Trial Chamber, this would leave us very short time to communicate with the accused and to prepare thoroughly our defence.

utterances.speaker: THE PRESIDING JUDGE
utterances.text: This, you understand, is not an indictment. This is merely the decision with respect to the deferral application. You understand that?

utterances.speaker: MR. BABIC
utterances.text: Yes, I understand it absolutely, but that would be the procedure. I mean, now what we can expect is the indictment according to the Rules of Procedure and Evidence. I mean, this was just a remark; I just wanted to say that we should try to avoid to have very short notices. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: THE PRESIDING JUDGE
utterances.text: Very good. Thank you. Mr. Lopicic, are there additional matters you wish to raise at this time?

utterances.speaker: THE PRESIDING JUDGE
utterances.text: No, thank you very much. Anything else from the Prosecutor?

utterances.speaker: THE PRESIDING JUDGE
utterances.text: Very good. Thank you. We are adjourned.
